description:
Get your brand's requested-alias -> served-model -> provider cross-tab.
Shows what you ASKED for versus what actually SERVED it — the fallback and routing picture behind
a task alias. Brand-scoped: these are your own requests.

The `provider` here is resolved through the key's integration, NOT the litellm wire prefix, so a
MiniMax model reports "minimax" and never "openai". If you are comparing against raw log fields
elsewhere, this is the column that is correct.
name: gate_flow
